title: 6 December 1969: George Harrison live at Empire Theatre, Liverpool with Delaney & Bonnie
content:
This was George Harrison’s fifth night performing with Delaney & Bonnie, the husband and wife act then on a brief tour of the UK.

Harrison performed on five of the tour’s six dates, playing two shows each night. He appeared in Bristol, Birmingham, Sheffield, Liverpool and Croydon. He didn’t perform at the Newcastle shows on 5 December, instead briefly leaving the tour to visit his unwell mother.

Several of the shows were also recorded for possible album release – the result was 1970’s Delaney & Bonnie & Friends On Tour With Eric Clapton. Harrison was credited as “Mysterioso”.

This was, of course, a homecoming show for Harrison. Although he kept a low profile during the tour, he is known to have sung songs including ‘Everybody’s Trying To Be My Baby’ on at least one occasion.

Page last updated: 25 May 2015
